operations.name: read_bar0_dword
operations.desc: Read 32-bit value from BAR0 base address

operations.name: read_bar0_word
operations.desc: Read 16-bit value from BAR0 base address

operations.name: read_bar0_byte
operations.desc: Read 8-bit value from BAR0 base address

operations.name: probe_bar0
operations.desc: Probe BAR0 memory region for accessibility
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0
try:
mov ebx, [0x0]
mov eax, 1
ret

operations.name: read_pci_config
operations.returns: PCI vendor and device ID combined value
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000000
mov dx, 0xcf8
out dx, eax
mov dx, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
ret
